one_liner: Enterprise B2C/B2B ecommerce platform (formerly Demandware) with SCAPI/OCAPI web APIs.

auth.notes: SCAPI/OCAPI use OAuth2 client-credentials (2-legged) grant via Salesforce Account Manager, registering a client ID/secret per API client.

access.notes: Commerce Cloud requires an existing provisioned B2C Commerce instance/sandbox tied to a paying customer or partner realm; unlike core Salesforce, there is no simple free self-serve Developer Edition for Commerce Cloud itself. Treated as sales-driven enterprise access; not fully confirmed this pass.

api.notes: Shopper/Commerce APIs (SCAPI) and legacy Open Commerce API (OCAPI) together cover a large surface (catalog, cart, orders, customers, admin).

verdict.rationale: OAuth2 API exists but requires a provisioned Commerce Cloud realm typically obtained via a Salesforce sales/partner relationship.
